topic: dashcams (beulraekbakseu): nearly every car records, insurance discounts, fault-ratio disputes, viewer-submitted crash videos, citizen traffic reports
title: In Korea, Almost Every Car Is Recording

slides.headline: In Korea, almost every car **is recording.**
slides.note: Front, back, and while it's parked.

slides.headline: It's called a **black box**
slides.body: 블랙박스, the Korean word for a dashcam. A small camera behind the mirror, usually one more on the rear window.

slides.headline: It never **really sleeps**
slides.body: Many keep watching after the engine is off. Bump a parked car and it saves the clip.

slides.headline: Insurers **give a discount**
slides.body: Most car insurers take a few percent off the premium if you register a dashcam. Few drivers skip it.

slides.headline: After a crash, **play the clip**
slides.body: Drivers don't argue on the road for long. The footage goes to the insurers, and they split the blame by percentage.

slides.headline: Blame comes **in numbers**
slides.body: It's called gwasil biyul (과실비율): 70 to 30, 80 to 20. There is an official chart for almost every kind of crash.

slides.headline: Crashes **become a TV genre**
slides.body: Drivers send their clips to YouTube shows where a lawyer judges who was at fault. Millions watch for fun.

slides.headline: Traffic reports **in 2025**
slides.body: Filed by ordinary people through a government app, many with dashcam video attached.

slides.headline: Elsewhere an optional gadget. **Here, standard gear.**
slides.body: In many countries a dashcam is for enthusiasts. In Korea, a car without one feels unfinished.

slides.headline: Korea, explained **by a Korean.**
slides.body: Follow for the context behind the things Korea does.

caption:
In Korea, almost every car has a dashcam, and it keeps recording even while parked.

After a crash, drivers play the clip, and the blame gets split by percentage.

Do drivers use dashcams where you live?
reply: One more: some Korean dashcam owners even get a thank-you from the police. Footage that helps solve a hit-and-run or a crime can earn a reward. Would you share your dashcam video with the police?
fact_check: 3장: 주차 녹화(상시·충격 감지) 기능 보편. 'many'로 표기.
4장: 블랙박스 특약 할인 보험사별 1~6%(손해보험협회 인용 보도), 노후 차량은 제외하기도. 특약 가입률 58.3%(이투데이, 과거 수치) — 카드엔 수치 안 씀.
5장: 사고 후 영상 보험사 제출, 과실비율 산정. 분쟁 시 손해보험협회 과실비율분쟁심의위원회.
7장: 한문철TV 등 블랙박스 사고 영상 판단 채널. 이름은 카드에 안 씀.
8장: 2025년 안전신문고 도로교통법 위반 신고 347만건(한경 2026-03-22, 연합뉴스 인용). 'many with dashcam video'로 표기, 비율 단정 안 함.
댓글: 경찰 블랙박스 영상 제보 시 감사장·포상 사례(뺑소니 등). 'can earn'으로 표기.
